# Notes for building / updating

* I copied in the `layouts/_default/baseof.html` to add in `MathJax` support. This might break with updates

## Search indexing

The site publishes:

* `https://stephenjayakar.com/robots.txt`, which allows all crawlers and points them to the sitemap.
* `https://stephenjayakar.com/sitemap.xml`, generated by Hugo.
* An IndexNow ownership key at the site root.

Page metadata is generated in `layouts/partials/head/seo.html`. New posts should
set a short, page-specific `description`; if it is omitted, the template uses a
trimmed content summary. A post's `[cover]` image is also used for Open Graph,
Twitter card, and `BlogPosting` metadata. Git commit dates supply `lastmod` for
existing content, while the content archetype includes explicit `description`
and `lastmod` fields for new posts.

Markdown images stored under `static/images` are also mounted as Hugo assets.
The image partial generates responsive WebP and source-format variants while
preserving the original static URL for external links and social metadata.

`./deploy.sh` submits only the added, changed, or deleted HTML URLs from that deployment to IndexNow after the GitHub Pages push. A failed IndexNow request is reported but does not turn a successful site deployment into a failure.

One-time Bing setup:

1. Sign in to [Bing Webmaster Tools](https://www.bing.com/webmasters/).
2. Add and verify `https://stephenjayakar.com/`.
3. In **Sitemaps**, submit `https://stephenjayakar.com/sitemap.xml`.
4. After the first deployment with this setup, use the **IndexNow** report to confirm URL notifications are arriving.

To notify IndexNow manually after the ownership-key file is live:

```sh
./scripts/submit-indexnow.sh https://stephenjayakar.com/posts/example/
```
